summary: Scammers impersonated Google and Coinbase support through phone calls emails and a fraudulent support website. The attackers used stolen personal information and urgency tactics to convince the victim to disclose account access information and visit a malicious support portal.
user_mistake: Trusted unsolicited support calls and followed instructions from callers claiming to represent account providers
prevention: Terminate unsolicited support calls and contact providers through official channels / Access support services only through verified websites
